specs.title: B1 · composed trigger title — the combobox name derives from a rendered title inside the field composition
B2 · trigger height rides the size axis — and lifts with the coarse rung
BR-10 · dir plumbing + dir=rtl layout integrity (no clipping / overflow)
BR-11 · @media print — legible palette artifact (chrome hidden, ink-economical)
cold load at a URL color paints the DERIVED field first frame (light)
cold load at a URL color paints the DERIVED field first frame (dark)
color-space select switches the active space
R15 · an achromatic colour then LCh does not kill the pane grid
R18 · a real image file develops a palette
R18 · a corrupt file surfaces a visible error, never a silent half-state
opens, publishes its rows, and its external link is operable
propose cycle reaches 'Propose color name' state for an unnamed color
the sub-layer cycle keeps exactly one active layer, the other inert
a successful propose returns the toolbar to its actions state
delete an owned remote palette DELETEs /palettes/<slug>
rename a remote palette PATCHes /palettes/<slug> with new name
flag a remote palette POSTs /palettes/<slug>/flag with reason
remix a remote palette POSTs /palettes/<slug>/fork with parent slug
save current palette persists to localStorage 'color-palettes'

suites.title: O-10a/e — title type locks (desktop dual grid)

specs.title: host-independence: family/style/weight identical; size ≡ each host's exact D2 token
phones: pane title floors one rung ABOVE heading (V9C-02); About = honest 2-line lock
every space inks its own locked line count at 1440px
every space inks its own locked line count at 390px
O-10d census — every heading across the 7-view walk speaks the display voice (+ the picker title)
O-10d census — user-data names (browse wall): display voice, ≤500, non-italic; line-clamp under the serif
O-10d census — the 390 phone band: the card name clamps to TWO lines under the serif
O-10d census — gated title surfaces: report dialog · versions drawer · hover-card titles
O-10d census — the rename-input morph re-verified under the serif (seeded local palette)
O-11 gates 1+2 — constitutive rest floor + feather, every pane (light)
O-11 gates 1+2 — constitutive rest floor + feather, every pane (dark)
O-11 gate 4 — compositor-only: pane-* keyframes carry ONLY transform/opacity; the CDP layout track is FLAT under a live scrub
O-11 gate 5 — engine/PRM coherence: rest state identical under PRM; every --pane-scroll binding is @supports-gated
O-11 gate 6 — one grammar: no in-card sticky beyond .pane-header; nothing out-stacks --z-header
O-12 · 1+2 — seat identity (flush, contained) + dock never occluded by the bead's arc
O-12 · 3 — idle frame cost at the seat: the live bead draws, at most once per frame, cadence in budget
O-12 · 4 — hover-active frame budget: sustained pointermove sweep p50 ≤ 20ms
O-12 · 5 — the backing-ratio feasibility leg: the settled canvas backing store is at full device resolution (never the 0.35× emerge-presize wreck; boot-G / R2)
